records.header_literal: C) POT v NKJ (8.42 a.m., November 4th); SS FÜR POT V OSM (3) 1430; RICHI-212; page heading 3rd NOVEMBER, 1918.
records.readable_german: 28/10. Schutzoffz. R. Schiffsausgl. Poti. K. A. sagt Poti 2400 Tons Tabak verladebereit. Wan Verladg moeglich. Schiffsausgl.
records.meaning: Reports tobacco ready for loading at Poti and asks when loading is possible; the numerical field 2400 remains a literal square-label reading.
notes: The native 212-slot source yields a complete 106-position raw stream.
The first SCHIFFZAUSGL is proposed as SCHIFFSAUSGL at one observed-coordinate substitution; the closing unedited SCHIFFSAUSGL is an exact internal word witness.
The raw R after SCHUTZOFFZ, transmitted WAN with one N, abbreviation VERLADG, labels K A and quantity 2400 are preserved.
Embedded 28X10, the page heading November 3 and intercept November 4 remain separate date layers.
The final-row ADVXD is visibly printed with X; earlier OCR used ADV?D. Source restoration of that observed X is not a historical mask fill.
